6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BS476 Part7 Surface Spread of Flame Test Apparatus Quantity - 1 set as detailed below. Scope of the work : BS 476 Part 7 equipment for surface spread of flame testing involves a radiant panel, water cooled specimen holder, pilot burner, heat flux sensor, and control systems to measure flame spread on building materials, requiring precise comp onents like an 850x850 mm panel, gas/air flow controls, and a calibration board to meet the standard's specifications for classifying material fire performance. T hus the specifications for setting up of the equipment required are. 1. Radiation Panel : A 850 mm x 850 mm square porous refractory-type burne r block. It is mounted vertically on a framework so that its center is 1250 m m (+100 mm) above floor level. The panel must reach temperatures up to 1 250°C and provide a stable gas-air mixture without surface flaming. (exactly as per BS476 part 7) 2. Specimen Holder : A water-cooled steel frame that holds the specimen at a 90° (+2°) angle to the face of the radiation panel. It includes a water-circulat ing system to ensure the outlet temperature does not exceed 35°C, preventi ng heat transfer from the holder from biasing the results. 3. 3 Kinds of sample holders for various thicknesses of materials, easy-to load specimens. 4. Pilot Burner : A ceramic or stainless steel burner with a nominal internal dia meter of 3 mm – 50mm. 5. Flowmeters & Pressure Regulators : Used for precise control of gas (natural gas or propane) and air supplies 6. Heat Flux Meter: 0-50 kW/m² for calibrating the radiant heat profile.

7. Calibration Board: A non-combustible board (885 mm x 270 mm x 25 mm) u sed to standardize the radiant heat exposure before testing. 8. Stainless steel made combustion chamber structure and support. 9. 12mm Thick calcium silicate wallboard, with a density of 1400 kilogram per cubic meter. 10. Standard stainless steel made chimney and cowl assembly, with black painti ng for less heat reflection. 11. 2 number of Thermocouple holders on the side of the cowl, fast mounting d esign. 12. 2 number mineral insulated thermocouples for temperature sensing. · 2 Pencil-type heating elements, each of 1000w rating and of 16mm in di ameter and 190mm in length. · Intelligent PID power controller with a feedback loop for accurate control of electric heating elements. · Stainless steel made gas burner. · Gas supply control system includes a manometer, gas flowmeter, gas pr essure regulating device, and gas control valves. · Visualized wattmeter for fast monitoring of the power output of the heati ng elements. · DAQ Data acquisition system, an automated record of the test data, includes time, the temperature in the cowl, power rating, etc. · Promoted software, function includes auto-calibration routine, automate d load the calibration data, auto standard test routine, test report export a nd storage.

Terms & Conditions: 1. Training should be given after installation and commissioning. 2. Supplier shall, at its own expense, pack, load, and deliver Goods to the Delivery Poi nt and in accordance with the invoicing, delivery terms, shipping, packing, and other instructions printed on the face of the Purchase Order or otherwise provided to Suppli er by Buyer in writing. 3. No charges will be allowed for freight, transportation, insurance, shipping, storage, handling, demurrage, cartage, packaging or similar charges unless provided for in th e applicable Purchase Order or otherwise agreed to in writing by Buyer. 4. Entire instrument should reach the delivery point, ICFRE-IWST Peenya Campus. Cust oms release etc is the sole responsible of the supplier. 5. Installation commissioning, Training (if any), servicing /attending problem during wa rranty period should be done at ICFRE-IWST Peenya Campus, Bangalaore 6. Any additional accessories for usage of the equipment should be included 7. Services during warranty period (min 1 year) services should be done in place 8. Work should be done within 60 days after receiving order. The Bidder should not sublet the contract. Payment will be made after receipt of invoice/Bill.
